digest.component_or_area: ticket store concurrent write handling and plan-review reconciliation
propositions: A verified successful description edit (14,997 chars) was silently reverted to a stale older revision (10,582 chars) on subsequent read, with no concurrency error reported.
Optimistic concurrency protection failed to reject or report the losing write; read-back verification passed immediately after the edit but the data was lost afterwards.
The ticket description was being edited while the ticket's own plan-review was in flight, emitting REVIEW_RESULT sidecar events that may have triggered store reconvergence.
A later unconditional whole-field EDIT event using stale client-held text silently overwrote a newer EDIT through last-writer-wins reduction, bypassing conflict detection.
The historical reducer-cache race (fixed in 0b964c82f5) allowed concurrent reducer generations to share stale cache state, causing old event hashes to be published with stale content.
